content.title: When do new episodes of 'The Boys' season 5 come out? See the full release schedule
content.text: Tomer Capone as Frenchie, Karen Fukuhara as Kimiko, Laz Alonso as M.M., Erin Moriarty as Annie, and Jack Quaid as Hughie in 'The Boys' season 5. Credit: Jasper Savage/Prime Video The Boys season 5 premiered April 8 on Prime Video.It consists of eight episodes, with new ones dropping weekly on Wednesdays after a two-episode premiere.The final season concludes on May 20. It's the end of the line for The Boys. The fifth and final season of Amazon Prime Video's superhero satire kicked off on April 8 with a two-episode premiere. With the series heading into its endgame, creator Eric Kripke told Entertainment Weekly that wrapping things up was no easy task. "It's so hard to land the plane in a way that's satisfying, and people retroactively will judge the series based on how they feel about the finale," he said, adding that this pushed him to "work twice as hard to get it right and not take anything for granted." The fans will be the ultimate judges, but for now here's everything you need to know about The Boys season 5, including its episode release schedule. When does The Boys season 5 come out? Karen Fukuhara as Kimiko, Karl Urban as Butcher, and Erin Moriarty as Annie in 'The Boys' season 5. Jasper Savage/Prime The Boys season 5 debuted its first two episodes on Wednesday, April 8. What is The Boys season 5 release schedule? (Left to right) Tomer Capone as Frenchie, Karen Fukuhara as Kimiko, and Laz Alonso as M.M. in 'The Boys' season 5. Prime Video New episodes of The Boys hit Prime Video every Wednesday at 3 a.m. ET, leading up to the big series finale on May 20. Here's the full release schedule for season 5: April 8: Episode 1April 8: Episode 2April 15: Episode 3April 22: Episode 4April 29: Episode 5May 6: Episode 6May 13: Episode 7May 20: Episode 8 What is The Boys season 5 about? Jensen Ackles as Solider Boy and Antony Starr as Homelander in 'The Boys' season 5. Jasper Savage/Prime Video In the fifth and final season of The Boys, Homelander (Antony Starr) has taken total control of the U.S. government, and the country is bending to his every twisted whim. Hughie (Jack Quaid), Frenchie (Tomer Capone), and M.M. (Laz Alonso) are locked away in "Freedom Camps," while Starlight (Erin Moriarty) scrambles to rally a resistance against near-impossible odds. Homelander is now obsessed with immortality and ruling like a god, but Butcher (Karl Urban), now a supe himself, possesses a deadly virus that could take down Homelander and wipe out the entire supe population. And just when things couldn't get any more dangerous, Homelander drags his father, Soldier Boy (Jensen Ackles), back into the fight. Quaid recently told EW that the show isn't exactly wrapping up with a "fairytale ending." "It's gonna be pretty gruesome," he said. "I didn't know exactly what it would be, but I knew whatever it was wasn't gonna be great for a lot of the characters. I didn't know who was gonna survive or not, and we really went there this season. There are characters that meet their end." He added, "We're getting heavy this season in a really interesting, truly grave way." Who's in the The Boys season 5 cast? Jack Quaid as Hughie in 'The Boys' season 5. Jasper Savage/Prime The main cast is returning for The Boys season 5, including Urban as Butcher, Starr as Homelander, and Quaid as Hughie. In addition to Ackles (Soldier Boy), Moriarty (Annie/Starlight), Alonso (M.M.), and Capone (Frenchie), the season will see the returns of Karen Fukuhara (Kimiko), Jessie T. Usher (A-Train), Chace Crawford (The Deep), Colby Minifie (Ashley), and Nathan Mitchell (Black Noir II), among others. Daveed Diggs as Oh Father in 'The Boys' season 5. Prime Video There are a few newcomers, too. EW previously reported that Hamilton alum Daveed Diggs is joining the season 5 cast — he portrays the corrupt religious supe Oh Father. Stranger Things season 4 star Mason Dye will also appear as Bombsight (a role he'll reprise on the prequel series Vought Rising), and Maitreyi Ramakrishnan (Never Have I Ever), Emma Elle Paterson (Murdoch Mysteries), and Dylan Colton (56 Days) make up the youth superhero team Teenage Kix. Season 5 will also bring in several characters from Gen V, including Jaz Sinclair as Marie, London Thor as Jordan, Lizzie Broadway as Emma, Maddie Phillips as Cate, Asa Germann as Sam, and Keeya King as Marie's sister Annabeth. Misha Collins and Jensen Ackles as Soldier Boy in 'The Boys' season 5. Prime Video The Boys season 5 is also bringing a little Supernatural magic back to our screens. Ackles will be joined by Jared Padalecki and Misha Collins in episode 5, with Kripke telling EW that their characters are "such douchebags." "Soldier Boy is no treat either, but they're just really not morally upstanding dudes," he said. "It's a blast to watch them play that. It was just so much fun." Where can I watch The Boys? The Boys is now streaming on Prime Video. Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter.
